A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same M-Pilot study, with 46 readable pages including Appendices A–H. Text, equations, figures and tables can be matched reliably across layout changes.

before.justification: v2 reports original personalization, mathematical reasoning and planning experiments in Tables 1–4, plus additional experiments, ablations and case studies in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons and the appendix experiments on MATH500, alternative controllers and training objectives.

M1.justification: The controller-generator procedure, feedback interactions, supervised initialization and iterative DPO training remain unchanged. The alternative SimPO formulation was already present in Appendix B.4.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same five LaMP tasks, GSM8K/GSM-Hard, MATH500 and six ALFWorld task types. No evaluated dataset, domain or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding main and appendix experiments, including RAG/PAG, the reasoning and planning baselines, Fermi/ORPO/LEAP/Bbox-Adapter, black-box controllers and self-consistency.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices D–F retain the same splits, metrics, model configurations, training budgets and inference limits, including three-shot mathematics prompts and the 50-action ALFWorld cutoff.

E4.justification: The IDPO, training-data, interaction-turn and user-history analyses are retained. Appendix comparisons involving SimPO and Qwen controllers, token-cost analyses and case studies also remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both retain the seed-42 disclosure in Appendix F.3.2 and the same statistical reporting. No repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals or significance tests are added.

E6.justification: Corresponding tables and plots retain their values and findings. For example, Table 3 reports M-Pilot GSM8K accuracy of 0.931 with gpt-3.5 in both versions, and Table 4 retains 96.27% ALFWorld success. Appendix results and case outcomes also match.

T1.justification: The trajectory and MDP definitions, SFT and iterative DPO derivations, and Appendix B.4 SimPO objectives are retained. No substantive mathematical revision or new proof appears.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about white-box control of black-box LLMs, feedback-driven multi-turn generation, self-improvement and effectiveness across reasoning, planning and personalization.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning guidance quality, transferability, sample efficiency and token savings are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same misuse and data-privacy limitations.

D1.justification: v4 newly states that code is publicly available and supplies a repository link in the abstract. The implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware descriptions and prompt templates in Appendices F and H remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited literature and research positioning in the introduction, Section 5 and Appendix C are retained. No cited work or substantive relationship to prior research is added or removed.

P1.justification: Limited front-matter edits add the code-availability sentence, Google DeepMind affiliations and a work-location footnote, while updating contribution markers. The section sequence and scientific prose remain stable.

P2.justification: Figure 2 is restyled while preserving its relationships and labels. Figures 3–4 and several appendix tables move as pages reflow; captions, table structures and empirical plots are retained. Pages 26–46 render identically.

improvement.justification: The new code-availability statement and repository link supply implementation-access information missing from v2, modestly improving reproducibility documentation. Scientific content and supporting evidence remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish repository completeness or executability.
